paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Belle II search for e+e- -> gamma a, a->gamma gamma, constraining ALP-photon coupling g_agamma. Mass range 0.2-9.7 GeV/c2, 95% CL limits at ~10^-3 GeV^-1. This is a collider/production search (not a DM haloscope), so no DM density assumed. Numerical g_agamma vs m_a values are provided in supplemental textfile and Fig.5 but not tabulated in the readable text; only the overall level (~10^-3 GeV^-1) is quoted, so data_points are approximate placeholders at the quoted level over the mass range. Masses converted: 0.2 GeV=2e8 eV, 9.7 GeV=9.7e9 eV. | Vision: Traced the dark blue Belle II exclusion boundary from Fig. 5. The excluded region is above the curve. The lower boundary reaches a minimum coupling of ~5.5e-4 GeV^-1 around m_a ~ 1 GeV, rising at both low mass (~0.2 GeV start) and high mass (~9.7 GeV). Coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_agamma in GeV^-1). Mass converted from GeV to eV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
